description: First-wins resolution order a conforming optimizer config loader must honor when selecting the agent's active configuration (baseline vs. optimizer-injected candidate). Only the local source is affected by an explicit config_dir override.

precedence.notes: Inline JSON blob carrying instructions/model injected by the optimizer. Highest priority.
The optimizer supplies a candidate id resolved to a config over the resolve endpoint.
The on-disk baseline directory. This is the ONLY source affected by an explicit config_dir argument or the OPTIMIZATION_LOCAL_DIR override.
No config resolved -> the SDK bridge degrades to environment defaults (env model, no instructions), so the agent runs identically with or without the optimizer.
